summary: Reworked the Updates card into two compact rows — DjangoLux and your application image — each with a status icon (green check when up to date, a down-arrow when an update is available) and the version, plus a last-checked line.
highlights: The Updates card now shows DjangoLux and your application image as two clear rows with at-a-glance status icons.
Click the DjangoLux icon to check for updates; a down-arrow appears on either row when an update is available.
